notes.title: Patch Notes for February 20th, 2024
notes.notes:
Hello Zapper Fans!

We know a number of users have been unable to launch Zapper: One Wicked Cricket on their machines. After some testing, it was determined that this was due to the .exe file path being too long. We've implemented a solution and encourage anyone affected previously to reinstall the game and try launching again.

Please reach out if you continue to experience any failures to launch the game!

Happy zapping!
